evidence.claim: Rule R6: Shared origin: Rule R6: Shared origin. When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Alert HHG-011 was opened following a customer dispute from customer C11923 regarding an online transaction of $131.30 (ID 3583368) on card C11923-K2. Although the isolated transaction model score was low at 0.011, graph analysis revealed that device D009621 was used within five hours across two other cards (C05595-K1 and C03938-K1) for similar amounts, with one linked transaction scoring 0.90. Card C11923-K2 also has ten prior confirmed fraud cases, six of which involved card-not-present fraud from new devices. The alert is confirmed as card-not-present fraud from a new device with a probability of 0.97, leading to transaction decline and monitoring of connected cards.

sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report details unauthorized card-not-present transactions identified across multiple cardholder accounts on December 29, 2016. The primary subject is cardholder C11923, holder of card C11923-K2, who initiated a direct fraud dispute regarding unauthorized online activity. On December 29, 2016, at 03:27:44 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3583368) for $131.30 was processed on card C11923-K2. The transaction originated via the online channel from device D009621, identified by profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | unknown | chrome 66.0 for android | unknown, which was flagged as a new device for this card. Cardholder C11923 confirmed non-authorization of the $131.30 purchase, which exceeded the cardholder's previous maximum transaction of $47.02 and lacked any recurring billing pattern. Internal graph analysis revealed that device D009621 was concurrently utilized within a five-hour window to conduct similar online transactions across two unrelated cards, C05595-K1 and C03938-K1. Specifically, device D009621 executed transaction 3582730 for $125.72 on card C05595-K1 and transaction 3582750 for $125.59 on card C03938-K1, with transaction 3582730 yielding a 0.90 fraud model score. Further review showed that card C11923-K2 had ten previous confirmed fraud cases on record, including six prior card-not-present compromises from new devices. Total fraudulent exposure directly incurred on card C11923-K2 is $131.30, with aggregated exposure across the three device-linked cards totaling $382.61. The bank has declined pending authorizations, applied step-up authentication restrictions, and initiated active monitoring across all linked compromised cards.

stop_reason: The investigation ended pursuant to policy section 6 because the fraud probability reached a decisive level of 0.97, established by the customer dispute, multi-card device links to high-scoring transactions, and extensive prior fraud history, meaning further inquiries would not alter the decision.
